text:
maria: Quick check — I'm about to merge a TF change that moves the telemetry serviceAccount into the tenant namespace (customer-alpha-telemetry). Can someone glance at the IRSA annotation I'm planning to add to the SA in kubernetes_service_account.tf? PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5421

devon: lgtm overall but two things: 1) make sure the RoleBinding is created in customer-alpha namespace (not infra) so the SA actually gets the RBAC. 2) verify the aws_iam_role has trust for web identity (sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity).

alex: quick nit — our helm chart supports toggling SA creation. If chart value is `serviceAccount.create: false` we should not patch the SA via Helm. For the annotation key use exactly `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`. Example we use elsewhere:
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/alpha-telemetry-role-2026
```

ops-bot: terraform plan summary (trimmed):
```
+ kubernetes_service_account.telemetry (new)
    metadata.annotations.eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/alpha-telemetry-role-2026"
```

devon: also double-check that the TF resources follow the naming convention so we can target them in immutable infra scripts (e.g., `kubernetes_service_account.telemetry-alpha`). Otherwise automation breaks.

anne: small operational note — BoundServiceAccountTokenVolume must be enabled on the EKS nodegroup for IRSA to work reliably. We saw flakes when projected token TTL was < 30s. Recommend adding a projected token volume to pods that use the SA, e.g.:
```yaml
volumes:
- name: aws-iam-token
  projected:
    sources:
    - serviceAccountToken:
        path: token
        audience: sts.amazonaws.com
        expirationSeconds: 86400
```
This avoids pod restarts during token rotation.

maria: good catch on the projected token, thanks. For the RoleBinding I'll add a tf resource `kubernetes_role_binding.telemetry-alpha` with namespace = var.namespace. I'll also add a fallback IAM mapping to infra-telemetry-role in case the tenant role isn't ready during rollout.

alex: +1. Also add a test in `deploy/helm-tests` that renders the SA manifest with `serviceAccount.create=true/false` combos so chart consumers won't break.

devon: I'll run a quick tfsec + plan locally and ping when done. @infra-oncall can we do the rollout tomorrow afternoon in the low-traffic window?

infra-oncall: 2–4pm PST tomorrow looks good for infra changes. Please include perf and error rate checks in the rollout checklist.

maria: thanks all — I'll push the PR updates now and mark for review. Will post the PR link here once CI passes. :thumbsup:
